name: Disable Security Profiles
description: Disables MPP and TCP security profiles to avoid unnecessary restrictions
commands:
netsh int tcp set security mpp=disabled
netsh int tcp set security profiles=disabled
revert22H2:
netsh int tcp set security mpp=enabled
netsh int tcp set security profiles=enabled
revert23H2:
netsh int tcp set security mpp=enabled
netsh int tcp set security profiles=enabled
revert24H2:
netsh int tcp set security mpp=enabled
netsh int tcp set security profiles=enabled
revertCommands:
netsh int tcp set security mpp=enabled
netsh int tcp set security profiles=enabled
